ordinances.title: Motorized Tricycle-for-hire and Motorela-for-hire Fare Rates Ordinance
ordinances.summary: Fuel-indexed base fare for tricycle-for-hire: P8.00 to P13.00 for the first 4 km across six pump-price bands, with a 20% student, senior and PWD discount. The ordinance publishes no succeeding per-kilometre rate.
ordinances.discountTerms: 20% statutory discount for students, seniors and PWDs on the applicable band.

ordinances.title: Transportation and Traffic Management Code of Butuan City
ordinances.summary: Article II (Tricycle Fares) sets no amount. It requires the ordinance-fixed fare to be displayed and penalises overcharging by P300-P600 or 10-30 days.
ordinances.discountTerms: Enforcement instrument; the discount follows RA 9994, RA 10754 and RA 11314.

ordinances.title: Adopting the approved tricycle route plan (TRP) of Butuan City
ordinances.summary: Route and zone framework for tricycles. It sets no fare.

ordinances.title: Requiring GPS devices on tricycles
ordinances.summary: Enforcement and telemetry requirement for tricycles. It sets no fare.
